caption: A fleece blanket is lifted out of the dryer, and a dryer sheet clings to its underside and rides along as the blanket is carried.

sa.check: A dryer with its door open.
A fleece blanket is lifted out.
A dryer sheet clings to the blanket's underside.
The dryer sheet rides along as the blanket is carried.
The dryer sheet is a thin flat sheet, not a sock or other garment.
The lift comes first and the clinging sheet shows as the blanket is carried.

pc.expect: The dryer sheet stays pressed against the blanket's underside, hanging on with nothing else holding it, as the blanket is lifted and carried; it comes off only when peeled.
pc.fail: The sheet drops off on its own as the blanket is lifted; or hangs a gap away from the blanket; or slides down the blanket and falls; or the sheet stays in the air where the blanket was when it is carried on.

pc.expect: The blanket hangs down from the arms; the dryer sheet clings to the fabric even on the underside; once peeled free and let go, the sheet falls.
pc.fail: The peeled sheet floats or rises; or the blanket stands out sideways from the arms; or the sheet climbs up the blanket; or the sheet hangs below the blanket without touching it.

pc.expect: The blanket is soft fleece that drapes in folds; the dryer sheet is a thin limp sheet that lies flat against it and wrinkles.
pc.fail: The blanket stands stiff like a board; or the sheet holds a flat rigid shape away from the fabric; or the sheet stretches like elastic when peeled; or the blanket flows like liquid.

pc.expect: Clothes left in the dryer stay still; the dryer stays put; the sheet moves only with the blanket.
pc.fail: Clothes in the drum rearrange as the blanket is lifted; or the dryer door swings by itself; or the sheet crawls across the blanket by itself.

pc.expect: One blanket and one dryer sheet; the sheet is a separate item on the blanket's surface; nothing merges, vanishes or passes through anything.
pc.fail: The sheet merges into the blanket; or a second sheet appears; or the sheet vanishes rather than being peeled; or the blanket passes through the dryer door.

pc.expect: The blanket's colour and pattern, the sheet's colour and the dryer stay the same.
pc.fail: The blanket changes colour; or the sheet changes colour or becomes a different item; or the dryer changes.
